achievements.title: National Robotic Olympiad — 1st Place
achievements.desc: Team UIU-Delta took gold at the Bangladesh Robotics Championship, defeating 47 teams from 30 universities.
achievements.full: Team UIU-Delta swept the Bangladesh Robotics Championship this year, defeating 47 teams from 30 universities nationwide. The team's autonomous navigation robot outperformed the field in both speed and precision trials, marking UIU's third consecutive year on the podium.

achievements.title: Professor Karim Receives Commonwealth Research Fellowship
achievements.desc: Dr. Md. Karimul Haque (EEE) awarded the prestigious Commonwealth Fellowship for sustainable energy research at University of Edinburgh.
achievements.full: Dr. Md. Karimul Haque of the Department of Electrical & Electronic Engineering has been awarded the Commonwealth Research Fellowship, one of the most competitive research awards in the Commonwealth. He will spend the next academic year at the University of Edinburgh researching grid-scale renewable energy storage.

achievements.title: UIU Rises to #3 in University Rankings Bangladesh 2026
achievements.desc: The QS Bangladesh University Ranking places UIU at #3 nationally, marking the highest position in the institution's history.
achievements.full: The newly released QS Bangladesh University Rankings 2026 place United International University at #3 nationally — its highest position to date. The ranking cited UIU's research output, industry partnerships, and student satisfaction scores as key drivers of the improvement.
